verses.en: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Davi, que lhe nasceram em Hebrom: Amnom, o primogênito, de Ainoã Jezreelita; o segundo Daniel, de Abigail de Carmelo;
verses.en_web: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.en_bbe: Now these were David's sons, whose birth took place in Hebron: the oldest Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite woman;

verses.en: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.pt: O terceiro, Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur; o quarto, Adonias, filho de Hagite;
verses.en_web: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.en_bbe: The third Absalom, the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, the son of Haggith;

verses.en: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.pt: O quinto, Sefatias, de Abital; o sexto, Itreão, de sua mulher Eglá.
verses.en_web: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
verses.en_bbe: The fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by Eglah his wife.

verses.en: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.pt: Estes seis lhe nasceram em Hebrom, de onde reinou sete anos e seis meses; e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos.
verses.en_web: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
verses.en_bbe: He had six sons in Hebron; he was ruling there for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

verses.en: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.pt: Estes lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Simeia, Sobabe, Natã, e Salomão, estes quatro de Bate-Sua, filha de Amiel.
verses.en_web: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.en_bbe: And in Jerusalem he had four sons, Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel;

verses.en: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.pt: Nasceram-lhe mais: Ibar, Elisama, Elifelete,
verses.en_web: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
verses.en_bbe: And Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet

verses.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.pt: Nogá, Nefegue, Jafia.
verses.en_web: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.en_bbe: And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia

verses.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.pt: Elisama, Eliada, e Elifelete, nove.
verses.en_web: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.en_bbe: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet, nine.

verses.en: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.pt: Todos estes foram os filhos de Davi, exceto os filhos das concubinas. E Tamar foi irmã deles.
verses.en_web: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.en_bbe: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of his servant-wives; and Tamar was their sister.

verses.en: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.pt: E o filho de Salomão foi Roboão, cujo filho foi Abias, cujo filho foi Asa, cujo filho foi Jeosafá;
verses.en_web: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

verses.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.pt: Cujo filho foi Jorão, cujo filho foi Acazias, cujo filho foi Joás;
verses.en_web: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.en_bbe: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

verses.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.pt: Cujo filho foi Amazias, cujo filho foi Azarias, cujo filho foi Jotão;
verses.en_web: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.en_bbe: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

verses.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.pt: Cujo filho foi Acaz, cujo filho foi Ezequias, cujo filho foi Manassés;
verses.en_web: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.en_bbe: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

verses.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.pt: Cujo filho foi Amom, cujo filho foi Josias.
verses.en_web: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.en_bbe: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

verses.en: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Josias foram: Joanã seu primogênito, o segundo Jeoaquim, o terceiro Zedequias, o quarto Salum.
verses.en_web: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Josiah: the oldest Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

verses.en: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jeoaquim foram: seu filho Jeconias, e seu filho Zedequias.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

verses.en: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.pt: E os filhos de Jeconias, o cativo, foram: seu filho Sealtiel,
verses.en_web: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jeconiah, who was taken prisoner: Shealtiel his son,

verses.en: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.pt: Malquirão, Pedaías, Senazar, Jecamias, Hosama, e Nedabias.
verses.en_web: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.en_bbe: And Malchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.

verses.en: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.pt: E os filhos de Pedaías foram: Zorobabel, e Simei. E os filhos de Zorobabel foram: Mesulão, Hananias, e sua irmã Selomite.
verses.en_web: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

verses.en: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.pt: E os cinco outros: Hasubá, Oel, Berequias, Hasadias, e Jusabe-Hesede.
verses.en_web: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
verses.en_bbe: And Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

verses.en: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Hananias: Pelatias, e Jesaías, os filhos de Refaías, os filhos de Arnã, os filhos de Obadias, e os filhos de Secanias.
verses.en_web: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

verses.en: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.pt: E o filho de Secanias foi Semaías; e os filhos de Samaías foram seis: Hatus, Igal, Bariá, Nearias, e Safate.
verses.en_web: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat, six.

verses.en: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Nearias foram três: Elioenai, Ezequias, e Azricão.
verses.en_web: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam, three.

verses.en: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Elioenai foram sete: Hodavias, Eliasibe, Pelaías, Acube, Joanã, Delaías, e Anani.
verses.en_web: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani, seven.
